title: City of Winter
sourceAnomalies: The rules (p.8, Components) state the Tradition Cards are separated into 11 Tradition Decks; the print-and-play card set contains 10 (9 named traditions plus the Umbra). The Design Notes sidebar (p.52) instead says ‘Ten Tradition Decks’.

The Mask Maker deck contains 24 cards where every other deck contains 25 (249 tradition cards total). Confirmed independently against CoW-TraditionCards.pdf, whose 250 pages are the 249 tradition cards plus the X-Card.
The Umbra deck prints two copies each of ‘who joins the Umbra’ and ‘a lie of the Umbra’.
Atlas p.9 (Temple Island) cites ‘We Join a Caravan (p.12)’; that location is on p.11 (p.12 is Through a Kingdom of Towers).
Atlas p.16 cites ‘...and seek work in Glowtown (p.19)’; Glowtown is on p.22 (p.19 is the Refuge).

The Transit Distance table (Atlas p.40) is symmetric but not internally consistent with the City Transit Map: Glowtown-Undertown is 1 and Undertown-Husk is 1, yet Glowtown-Husk is printed as 7+. The table is reproduced exactly as printed.
Wintermount appears on the City Transit Map (p.38, Moon Path) and has its own location page (p.37), but is absent from the Transit Distance table (p.40).
The Wandering Borough location card is titled ‘The Wandering Burrough’ and its eighth scene is printed ‘WANDERERING’; the rules use ‘Wandering Borough’ throughout.
